class.name: GameLog
class.brief_description: The game's log, as Python's logging: named loggers ([GameLogger]) and the handlers of their lines ([GameLogHandler]). For development-only logs, prefer Godot's built-in functions such as push_error(), push_warning(), print(), and print_rich().
class.description: GameLog is available as an Engine singleton named "GameLog". A logger is taken by its id - [method get_logger] creates a logger missing yet - and kept where a script logs more than once: [codeblock] var _log: GameLogger = GameLog.get_logger("ai") _log.debug("SetVelocity 40") GameLog.get_logger("game").error("Failed to load route") [/codeblock] There is no hierarchy of loggers. A line goes at once - nothing is kept in memory - to the logger's handlers. GameLog only manages: a handler is registered by name ([method register_handler]) and assigned to loggers by name ([method assign_handler]), and GameLog attaches it to them. One handler may serve many loggers, and the handler, the logger and the assignment may come in any order: [codeblock] var handler: GameLogFileHandler = GameLogFileHandler.open("user://logs/gameplay.log") GameLog.register_handler("gameplay.log", handler) GameLog.assign_handler("gameplay", "gameplay.log") GameLog.assign_handler("scenario", "gameplay.log") [/codeblock] The logger "game", of the game's own messages, is made with the log.

method.name: assign_handler
method.description: Assigns the handler [param handler_name] to the logger [param logger_id]. It is attached to the logger at once when both exist, else when the second of them comes.

method.name: create_logger
method.description: Creates the logger [param logger_id] and emits [signal logger_created]. An error when it exists already.

method.name: get_logger
method.description: The logger [param logger_id], created when it is missing yet (as Python's logging.getLogger()).

method.name: get_loggers
method.description: The ids of the loggers, in the order they were created.

method.name: register_handler
method.description: Registers [param handler] by [param handler_name] and attaches it to the loggers it is assigned to. An error when the name is taken.

method.name: remove_logger
method.description: Removes the logger [param logger_id]: [signal logger_removing] is emitted first, then its handlers are detached - a script keeping it logs to nobody. Its assignments stay for a logger of the same id created later.

method.name: unassign_handler
method.description: Takes the handler [param handler_name] off the logger [param logger_id].

method.name: unregister_handler
method.description: Detaches the handler [param handler_name] from every logger and forgets it; its assignments stay.

signal.name: logger_created
signal.description: Emitted when a logger is created.

signal.name: logger_removing
signal.description: Emitted when a logger is about to be removed ([method remove_logger]), while it still has its handlers.
